fee_notes: Royalty is 14% of Gross Receipts with tiered annual minimums: Year 1 no minimum; Year 2 minimum $5,000; Year 3 minimum $8,000; Years 4-5 minimum $11,000 (minimums are annual, not monthly). Advertising fee is 5% of Gross Receipts. Holdover Fee adds an additional 2% of Gross Receipts on top of standard royalties when operating under an expired Franchise Agreement. Interest on late amounts is 12% per annum. Transfer Fee is $5,000 per territory. Commission Fee is 10% of sales price (min $5,000) if franchisor assists in selling the franchise. Pre-existing tax client exclusion fee is $5 per client annually. Transmitter/Electronic Filing/Software Fee is $25.00 per Easy Advance per approved loan; in California, $39.95 handling fee per Refund Transfer. Set-Off may include 14% royalty + 5% advertising fee plus 25% liquidated damages for misconduct.
raw_excerpt:
Royalties 14% of Gross Receipts subject to the following minimums: First year- No minimum royalties; Second year- minimum $5,000; Third year - minimum $8,000; Fourth and fifth year – minimum $11,000 | Royalties are due on 5th day of month with any balance owed to achieve minimum royalty due May 5th for the twelve months ending April 30th.
Advertising 5% of Gross Receipts | 5th day of month
Exclusion of Pre-Existing Tax Clients** $5 per client | Upon closing of franchise purchase, and thereafter annually
Interest 12% | After amounts are owed that are more than fifteen days past due
Transfer Fee (Franchise Agreement) $5,000 per territory | Upon transfer of business.
Commission Fee 10% of the sales price, subject to a minimum of $5,000 | At time of sale of your business.
Customer Refunds, Penalty & Interest, Unpaid Send a Friends | The amount of tax preparation fee, Financial Product fees, misdelivered check amount, penalty and interest, or unpaid Send a Friend or E-Send a Friend.
Sales or Gross Receipts Tax | If required by the state or locality
Transmitter, Electronic Filing, Handling or Software Fee $25.00 per Easy Advance for each approved loan; In California, $39.95 handling fee for each Refund Transfer.
Set-Off 14% of Gross Receipts and advertising fee of 5% of Gross Receipts plus an additional 25% for liquidated damages.
Holdover Fee An additional 2% of Gross Receipts on top of the standard Royalties Monthly if holding over under an expired Franchise Agreement.
Liquidated Damages for Premature Closure during Holdover Period An amount equal to the Royalties paid in the six months prior to closing.
Assessment Related to Under-statement of Revenues The costs of the review and interest of 12% per annum on the understated amount.
Sublease Fee Up to $1,000.
Attorneys' Fees and Costs An amount equal to our costs and expenses.
